1053961089.description: Our Member's Mark Travel Jogger features a comfortable, flattering fit with a wide pull on waistband, rib cuffs, and 2 side pockets, making this a go to item for any climate or situation. The drawcord at the waist allows for adjustability of fit, and the seaming at the front and back adds some femineity and detail to the jogger. The breathable, 4-way stretch fabric provides both functionality and comfort – topped off with the extreme softness and perfect weight for both those warmer and cooler days. Keeping sustainability in mind, our premium fabric is made from recycled Nylon. This jogger matches perfectly back to the Member's Mark™ Travel Jacket, your favorite tee, workout top, or your go-to hoodie, and comes in a variety of solid classic colors that make pairing back easy. This jogger is ideal for a casual work look, a quick workout, or lounging at home in-front of the TV, and can be dressed up or down depending on your look. Of course as the name states, this is a great travel piece, given the storage, functionality, and stretch – you will never be uncomfortable on a plane or train again. This item comes in a range of sizes from XS – 3XL and is an item that...

1053961090.description: Discover the Member's Mark™ Men's Long Sleeve Flat Back Rib Henley, your new everyday essential. Designed for modern, on-the-go lifestyles, this henley combines comfort, durability, and timeless style. Whether worn alone or layered, it's a dependable choice for year-round versatility.

1053961091.description: Member's Mark™ Everyday Legging is crafted from premium Recycled Nylon fabric, offering a light to mid-weight feel that resembles a soft second skin. The fabric is designed to provide a flattering fit for all body types, ensuring comfort and style in every wear. Its 4-way stretch allows for unrestricted movement, making it ideal for a wide range of activities.

1053961092.description: Experience super-soft comfort that goes wherever you do. The Member's Mark Sandwash Collection features a knit fabric that's soft, drapey, and designed to feel exceptionally comfortable on your skin.

1053961093.description: Our Member's Mark Women's Everyday Yoga Pant is a great addition to any closet. The premium recycled nylon fabric leans towards a light to mid weight, which feels like a soft second skin. The clean style lines provide a flattering fit on all body types, as well as a 4-way stretch fabric that moves with you and allows for a full range of motion.

1053961094.description: Dockers Men's Casual Dress Shoe will elevate and refine any dress-casual outfit you have planned. The easy care synthetic leather uppers and detailed stitching are coupled with a sleek, lightweight and flexible Active Rebound outsole to bring you a shoe that delivers exceptional comfort and style, and seamlessly pairs with any attire from slacks to jeans. Designed for style and built for comfort, these shoes feature Dockers' new Active Rebound technology and Supreme Comfort footbed, complete with microfiber lining and moisture-wicking sock cover, ensuring you have the comfort and support you need to put your best foot forward. With the comfort of a sneaker built in and classic oxford styling, these Dockers casual shoes are what you need to elevate any dress casual look.

1053961095.description: The Member's Mark Men's Relaxed Fit Premium Stretch Denim Jeans pair everyday comfort with timeless style. Premium stretch denim adds flexibility and freedom of movement, while the relaxed fit through the hip and leg keeps you comfortable from morning to night.

1053961096.description: Axel Original Denim Boot Cut Jeans are crafted for those who value quality and style. Made with a premium blend of 62% cotton, 30% polyester, 6% viscose, and 2% spandex, these jeans offer exceptional durability and comfort. Reinforced pressure points and heavy-weight thread ensure they stand the test of time, making them a reliable choice for any occasion.

1053961097.description: Step up your casual wardrobe with the Adidas Women's VL Court 3.0 Shoes. Designed with smooth leather and a plush lining, these shoes deliver a sleek look while ensuring maximum comfort. Whether you're heading out for a casual day or running errands, these shoes are the perfect blend of style and practicality.

1053961098.description: The Free Country Women's Snow Jacket is designed to keep you cozy and comfortable during all your winter adventures. Whether you're skiing, snowboarding, or enjoying a snowball fight, this jacket offers unbeatable protection and freedom of movement with its 4-way stretch fabric. Pair it with the Free Country Women's Base Layer Shirt and Snow Pant for the ultimate winter outfit.

1053961100.description: A beautiful 1.96 carat total weight lab created "Dutch Marquise" cut diamond ring with round diamond accent stones in 18 karat gold with F color and VS2 clarity would be a timeless and elegant addition to any jewelry collection. This ring would make a wonderful gift for your significant other or a treasured purchase for oneself. It features a "dutch marquise" cut diamond center with a weight of approximately 1.50 carats, accompanied by 32 round cut side diamonds weighing an approximate total 0.46 carats. Each diamond is certified by the International Gemological Institute as F color and VS2 in clarity, thus ensuring you that your purchase is of beautiful quality. All the diamonds are prong set. These settings allow for more light to enter the diamonds, focusing one's eyes on the beautifully crafted lab created diamonds.

1053961101.description: High polished two-toned bypass hinged bangle is crafted in sterling silver and 14 Karat yellow gold. Elegant and sophisticated wrist wear, instantly elevates attire. Light, flexible and shiny, this hinged bangle is an easy accessory for everyday use. This combines two precious metals, sterling silver and 14k yellow gold for a luxurious look and feel. Sturdy in construction, versatile and easy to wear. Choose to wear alone or stack them with other bracelets, create a unique look each time you wear. The bracelet has a lobster clasp closure for security.

1053961102.description: Timeless sterling silver omega chain with faceted oval gold charm encased in silver setting. Classic sterling silver 3mm omega adjustable chain 16"" + 2"" extender for total of 18"" length. Bold and stylish, flexible and masterfully crafted to maximize shine and durability. The unique charm combines bold facets in the gold dome bringing to life sparkly flashes of bright gold color. The grillback gives the pendant a smooth and beautiful finished look. Choose to wear the omega chain alone, with the dazzling charm or stack additional charms to create personalize story. The possibilities are endless with this versitile chain necklace. The closure is lobster clasp for security. Easy gift for any occasion.

1053961103.description: Solid foldover heart tassel lariat necklace is carefully crafted in 14k yellow gold. Glamourous and bold, this special necklace is a statement piece that adorns the neckline with bright sparkle and flash. Soft to touch, each strand in the tassel is meticulously joined by a ribbed bar creating a lariat effect. Y shaped design embodies feminine beauty and strength, perfect accessory for special occasions. Svelte and sophisticated necklace instantly elevates any outfit. Tassel measures 1.75"" drop length, while the chain length is 18"". Machine made for precision and fluidity ensuring top quality.

1053961104.description: This lovely S Collection Diamond Flower Pendant is both elegant and classy, featuring a total of .50 CT T.W of round brilliant-cut white diamonds. The 7 stones that form the flower are pressure and prong set, hand crafted in 14K yellow gold with a fine Milgrain and high polished finish. The pendant is perfectly complemented by a Pin Style chain that is adjustable from 16" to 18" to suit your desired length and is securely fastened with a lobster claw clasp. This necklace is certified by the world renowned International Gemological Institute with a color and clarity of HI, SI, certificate included. Committed to ethical practices, all diamonds are natural and conflict-free, reflecting our dedication to responsible sourcing.IGI certification is a process by which diamonds are evaluated and Certified to verify their authenticity and quality. The International Gemological Institute (IGI) is the world's largest independent diamond certification and appraisal institute.H-I is a color grade for diamonds, considered to be a desirable, near colorless grade that appears white to the unaided eye. SI is a clarity grade of diamonds which means the stone is slightly included with...

1053961106.description: Elevate your jewelry collection with the timeless brilliance of this 0.80 Carat Total Weight Oval Shaped Diamond Earrings and Pendant Set in 14K Gold. Designed to dazzle, this matching set brings together classic elegance and modern craftsmanship, making it the perfect choice for both everyday sophistication and special occasions.

1053961107.description: Member's Mark Honeycrisp Apple Lattice Pie is our classic dessert for all occasions. We wanted to provide our members with a traditional American staple for any holiday, big or small, that is easy to execute.

1053961109.description: Sink your teeth into flaky, sweet pastries with the classic Member's Mark Apple Turnover. These baked apple turnovers are made fresh daily in your local Club and are excellent for special occasions or daily snacking.

1053961110.description: This 2.25 C.T. T.W. Baguette and Round Cut Diamond Eternity Band in 14K White Gold is a timeless expression of luxury and modern craftsmanship. Expertly designed and IGI appraised for quality assurance, this exquisite ring showcases a brilliant combination of 129 diamonds totaling 2.25 carats. The alternating baguette and round cut diamonds are meticulously set in both pavé and prong settings, creating a seamless flow of sparkle that encircles the entire band. Each diamond, with HI color and I1 clarity, is carefully selected to maximize brilliance and fire.

1053961111.description: Indulge in the delectable 10" Tres Leches Style Cake, a dessert that redefines richness and refreshment. Crafted in Club for peak freshness, this sponge cake is soaked in a Tres Leches style soak, delivering a moist and melt-in-the-mouth texture that is sure to delight your taste buds. It's a crowd-pleasing classic taken to a whole new level of deliciousness.

1053961112.description: This stunning elongated cushion cut lab-grown diamond ring is a masterpiece of modern elegance. Featuring a dazzling 3.00 ct center stone, its unique design ensures a timeless and sophisticated look that will captivate attention. The elongated cushion cut enhances the brilliance and sparkle, making it a perfect choice for special moments.

1053961113.description: Member's Mark Variety Pack Muffins make a delicious breakfast or brunch addition that everyone will enjoy. Baked fresh daily in our clubs, this variety pack includes two each of three great flavors: banana nut, blueberry and double chocolate.

1053961115.description: A beautiful 1.96 carat total weight lab created "Dutch Marquise" cut diamond ring with round diamond accent stones in 18 karat gold with F color and VS2 clarity would be a timeless and elegant addition to any jewelry collection. This ring would make a wonderful gift for your significant other or a treasured purchase for oneself. It features a "dutch marquise" cut diamond center with a weight of approximately 1.50 carats, accompanied by 32 round cut side diamonds weighing an approximate total 0.46 carats. Each diamond is certified by the International Gemological Institute as F color and VS2 in clarity, thus ensuring you that your purchase is of beautiful quality. All the diamonds are prong set. These settings allow for more light to enter the diamonds, focusing one's eyes on the beautifully crafted lab created diamonds.

1053961116.description: Member's Mark Chantilly Bar Cake is our premium dessert for all occasions. We wanted to provide our members a ready to serve refreshing and equally delicious dessert option for all occasions. With this cake serving ~ 8-10 people, it will have everyone wanting more at the end of a meal.

1053961117.description: Indulge in a scrumptious treat with our mixed pack of Member's Mark Birthday Cake and Cookies & Cream Cake Pops. Perfect for satisfying your sweet cravings, this convenient pack combines the rich, creamy flavors of Cookies & Cream with the celebratory essence of Birthday Cake. Ready to eat and hassle-free, these cake pops are ideal for any occasion.

1053961118.description: Indulge in the ultimate luxury with this exquisite multi-gemstone necklace. Crafted with the finest attention to detail, this necklace is a true masterpiece. The 14 karat yellow gold setting adds a touch of opulence, while the vibrant blue topaz, amethyst, peridot, citrine, and garnet gemstones are carefully selected to ensure a stunning and dazzling display of color.

1053961119.description: Bring home everything your family needs to begin a magical Christmas tradition with this Elf Tradition and Carrier Bundle. This all-in-one holiday set includes an adoptable Scout Elf™ with brown or blue eyes, flexible, poseable limbs, an artfully illustrated storybook, keepsake box and official adoption certificate. Children will love discovering their Scout Elf in new spots throughout the season as they create Christmas cheer, inspire merry moments and help celebrate the magic of Santa's Nice List.

1053961120.description: Member's Mark Caramelized Banana Nut Loaf is a comforting delight that combines rich, moist cake with the natural sweetness of real bananas. Each bite offers a perfect balance of buttery, creamy flavors and crunchy pecans, topped with a caramelized pecan and caramel finish. This loaf is a versatile treat, ideal for breakfast, lunch, or as a satisfying snack or dessert.

1053961121.description: Bring coastal charm to your look with the Sol & Mer Beaded Gingham Lobster and Beaded Bicycle Flower Basket Baguette Shoulder Bag. Featuring intricate hand-applied beadwork, this structured baguette silhouette showcases a vibrant lobster motif set against classic blue gingham for a fresh seaside-inspired feel. The slim shoulder strap offers easy carry, while the detailed craftsmanship adds texture and personality to any outfit. Perfect for warm-weather outings, vacations, or adding a playful statement to everyday style.

1053961122.description: Impress and indulge your guests with a Member's Mark 10" Celebration Cake—the perfect dessert for birthdays, family gatherings, special occasions.

1053961123.description: High polished two-toned oval link bracelet is crafted in sterling silver and 14 Karat yellow gold. For every 5-silver links, the 6th oval link is 14k yellow gold, creating a balanced pattern and luxurious sleek look. This combines two precious metals, sterling silver and 14k yellow gold in one beautifully well-made bracelet in 8.5"" length. Sturdy in construction, versatile and easy to wear. Choose to wear alone or stack them with other bracelets, create a unique look each time you wear. The bracelet has a lobster clasp closure for security. Fit for any occasion, giftable for both women and men.

1053961124.description: Festive Serveware for Holiday Entertaining – Featuring Peanuts or Grinch

1053961125.description: Get ready to bring flavor and fun to your next gathering with our White and Chocolate Cupcakes with Buttercream Icing. Packed in convenient large-capacity containers, these cupcakes are the ultimate party companions, ready to delight guests of all ages.

1053961126.description: Treat your family and friends with a classic snack with Member's Mark Cookies Variety Pack, 18 ct.. This large pack is perfect for sharing with others.

1053961127.description: Member's Mark Blueberry Muffins are ready to please—whether you're in a rush or sitting down for a nice leisurely breakfast or snack. They are made with genuine blueberries and are baked fresh on a daily basis, which gives them that fresh taste that people have grown to love.

1053961128.description: Bring the magic of Disney to your holiday décor with this 11-inch Animated Musical Village. Featuring a snow-covered village adorned with classic Disney details, this piece is a delightful addition to any festive setting. Vibrant LED lighting and an animated bouncing tower add a touch of whimsy and movement to your seasonal display.

1053961129.description: Member's Mark Double Chocolate Muffins are an anytime, any day treat that is beloved by millions. The fresh, chocolaty flavor is a great way to launch your day or keep it going.

1053961130.description: Holiday Bakeware for Memorable Gatherings – Featuring The Grinch by Dr. Seuss or Peanuts Cartoon

1053961131.description: Transform your home this holiday season with the Member's Mark 9' Prelit Holiday Garland, exclusively available at Sam's Club. Crafted with a mix of lush, life-like spruce and needle pine, this garland is gently frosted with snow for a festive touch. Adorned with shatterproof ornaments in pearlized champagne gold and silver, it exudes sophistication. White and green citrus leaves, glittered pinecones, faux ivory berries, painted faux magnolia leaves, and seeded eucalyptus clusters complete its elegant design. Pair it with the coordinating wreath, sold separately, for a cohesive holiday look.

1053961132.description: Add height and elegance to your holiday decorations with the Member's Mark 48" Classic Flocked Topiary. Standing four feet tall, this beautifully shaped topiary features lush greenery, creating a full and dimensional silhouette that exudes timeless charm and festive appeal.

1053961133.description: Transform your indoor spaces with the Member's Mark antiqued 3-piece metal Jingle Bell Decor, exclusively available at Sam's Club. Featuring a luxurious antiqued finish in gold or red, these jingle bells bring a touch of opulence and festive cheer to your home. Their intricate detailing and classic design make them a perfect addition to both traditional and modern holiday themes.

1053961134.description: The Member's Mark 50ct Flickering LED Candlestick Lights are a charming addition to your holiday décor. Designed to evoke the warmth of the good old days, these flickering lights are sure to delight your guests and create a festive atmosphere. Battery-operated for convenience, they can be placed anywhere to add a touch of holiday magic.

1053961135.description: Elevate your holiday décor with the Member's Mark Prelit 3 Wreath Door Hanger, a stunning three-in-one design that makes a bold statement on your front door. Each 18-inch wreath features a lifelike blend of lush cedar, pine, and juniper, complemented by green-painted magnolia leaves, natural pinecones with a glittered finish, and ivory berries. The centerpiece of each wreath is a flat, shatterproof ornament in pearlized champagne gold, adding a touch of sophistication to your seasonal display. The elegant scrolled metal hanger ensures effortless installation on any door.

1053961136.description: Rustic wood-like finish for a natural and timeless look

1053961138.description: Keep him ready for any adventure with this playful 2pc Cozy Set. Featuring a long sleeve pullover and coordinating pants, this set showcases bold character-inspired graphics on the pullover's front and sleeve. The pants complement the look with either an allover print or a character graphic on the lower leg, creating a cool, coordinated outfit.

1053961139.description: Elevate your MVP's wardrobe with the Champion Boys Oversized Rugby Polo, a perfect blend of sporty and casual style. Rugby polos have transcended the field to become a staple in everyday fashion, and this design takes it up a notch with an oversized fit and dropped shoulders for a contemporary edge.

1053961140.description: The Express Women's Fashion Scuba Top is the ultimate blend of style and comfort, perfect for your next getaway. Designed to transition seamlessly from daytime adventures to evening outings, this pullover is a must-have addition to your vacation wardrobe.

1053961141.description: The Woolrich Women's Wrap is designed to elevate your outerwear collection with its luxurious softness and unique design. Combining the elegance of a shawl with the practicality of a poncho, this wrap offers a striking silhouette that effortlessly drapes over your shoulders.

1053961142.description: Bring your child's favorite characters to life with these delightful quarter-zip fleece pullovers featuring Mickey & Minnie Mouse, Disney Princesses, and Hello Kitty & Friends. Each design is adorned with vibrant all-over artwork and scenic back graphics, making every angle a magical experience.

1053961143.description: Bring excitement to your child's wardrobe with these vibrant quarter-zip fleece pullovers featuring designs inspired by Mario, Spider-Man, and Minecraft. Each pullover showcases bold character artwork and detailed scenic graphics, making them stand out from every angle.

1053961144.description: The Coleman Canvas Shirt Jacket is designed for ultimate warmth and comfort. Lined with brushed plaid polar fleece, this jacket ensures a cozy feel while complementing the jacket's color. The garment-washed cotton exterior adds softness, making it ready to wear straight out of the store.

1053961145.description: The Coleman Fleece Lined Bonded Pants are designed to keep you cozy and comfortable during the cooler months. Featuring a bonded canvas and fleece lining, these pants provide an extra layer of insulation while allowing for natural movement. Whether you're outdoors or relaxing, these pants are a perfect choice for fall.

1053961146.description: The Eddie Bauer Women's Long Sleeve Tee is a wardrobe essential designed for year-round versatility. Made from 58% cotton, 39% modal, and 3% spandex, this tee features a brushed finish for an ultra-soft feel against your skin. Its classic, fitted silhouette makes it an easy choice for everyday dressing.

1053961147.description: The State Of Mine Men's Printed Sherpa Quarter Zip Pullover is crafted from ultra-soft 325gsm sherpa fleece with a brushed back interior, ensuring warmth and comfort during chilly days. Its quarter zip design allows for easy layering over your favorite tee, while the true-to-size fit provides a relaxed feel without added bulk.

1053961148.description: Discover the perfect combination of style and comfort with this oversized mock neck top. Designed with a relaxed, loose fit, it offers an effortless silhouette that's ideal for everyday wear. Whether you're lounging at home or stepping out, this top ensures you stay comfortable without compromising on style.

1053961149.description: The Outdoor Voices Sherpa Jacket is your go-to layer for cool mornings, unpredictable afternoons, and chilly evenings. Crafted from heavyweight 420 GSM sherpa made from 100% recycled material, this jacket offers a softer, richer, and more elevated feel compared to traditional sherpa. Its brushed interior enhances comfort, making it perfect for layering or wearing solo.
